entities.name: Query protein bL21
observations: 103 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q057J2, a large ribosomal subunit protein bL21.
Predicted molecular weight 12,426.844 Da, theoretical pI 10.124, and charge at pH 7 of +17.83.
Pfam Ribosomal_L21p (PF00829.27) spans residues 1–101 with i-Evalue 3.8e-29.
Homology-supported function is 23S rRNA binding in the presence of ribosomal protein L20.

entities.name: Ribosomal protein bL21
observations: Bacterial 50S ribosomal-subunit protein that contacts L20 and binds 23S rRNA.
Associated GO terms include ribosome, cytoplasm, rRNA binding, structural constituent of ribosome, and translation.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: bL21 contributes to the 50S ribosomal subunit and therefore to bacterial translation.
